checkedAlternates.risk: Peanuts are commonly roasted and eaten as nuts.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Botanically, peanuts are underground pods of the legume Fabaceae family (group-1), not true tree nuts (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: Almonds have a hard woody shell.
checkedAlternates.resolution: An almond is the seed inside a fleshy peach-like drupe (group-4), not an indehiscent true nut (group-3).
